title: Flow past a cylinder: potential and real flow, rotation and the Magnus effect
status: reviewed and locally validated; passes 1-9 complete; gate 6b passed round 2 (0 blocking)
transcript_provenance: Publisher-uploaded English captions (NPTEL YouTube channel, non-automatic track)
source_uncertainties: All publisher captions read fully and sequentially; every contact sheet scanned (L30A s01-s05,L30B s01-s03,L31 s01-s07). Videos intentionally deleted; no playback, recovery or frame extraction claimed.
Title cards read35,36,37 while manifest uses30A,30B,31; public labels use manifest. Elapsed times unchanged.
L30A switches theta origin to front for noncirculating Cp. Chapter retains CCW theta from+x globally and names alternative vartheta=pi-theta; phi reserved for potential.
L30A speech briefly uses sine in doublet potential then corrects it (456-480s); f0019 confirms cosine and normalized coefficient m, with m/U=R2 in f0044. Negative polar-radius wording not retained.
L31 f0028 has a transient missing minus in Vtheta; f0036 and f0073 show corrected minus. Derivative of phi fixes sign independently.
L31 prescribed circulation-to-spin relation is explicitly ad hoc in speech (2580s); chapter proves total wall velocity still violates no slip. No physical law Gamma=2piOmegaR2 claimed.

L30B Cp sketches are qualitative. Claims of generally positive turbulent base pressure, universally thinner turbulent layer, universal minimum Cp bounds, attachment of every streamlined body, or base pressure alone determining total drag were not promoted to general results.

L31 f0111 slide gives Re200 two-dimensional steady intervals1.91<alpha<4.34 and alpha>4.70 within alpha<=5; spoken about2/about5 are rounded. These values are cited as lecture computational examples, not independently recovered raw data.

JFM2003 author-uploaded full-text page303 was accessible as ResearchGate text and agrees on intervals, but IAS PDF requests403/404 and publisher route failed; no journal-PDF rendering or page gate is claimed for this paper. Author publication list has literal Errata with no readily exposed linked correction; relevance unverified. Not listed as a page-checked research reference.

L31 closing AR12 three-dimensional slide(f0121) and speech distinguish transient at alpha5 from final steadier configuration. Mittal2004 and Navrose etal2015 are named on an earlier slide but their pages were not checked; no general alpha5 stability claim is made.
Spinning-ball examples retained only as model-boundary discussion; Frisbee sustained lift is not attributed to the cylinder Magnus mechanism.

Prandtl PDF was already present, but pp4-5 rendered and actually read anew. Yang2023 downloaded from publisher, ppA15-1,A15-5 rendered and read; no historical review claims from its introduction treated as primary results.
Constructed density1.2kg/m3 has no thermodynamic state attributed; no temperature-dependent property claim. Synthetic base Cp values and all numerical geometry are teaching constructions.
